title: Nav2 for Humanoid Robots Troubleshooting Guide
description: This guide provides solutions to common issues encountered when running Navigation 2 (Nav2) with humanoid robots. Humanoid navigation presents unique challenges due to balance requirements, kinematic constraints, and complex dynamics that differ from traditional wheeled robots.
